page.title: Your emails already hold a memory of your nights out.
page.lead: WH3RE can find the confirmations in there: restaurants, hotels, activities, events and trips.
page.addressUnavailable: Your forwarding address isn’t available yet.
page.privacy: WH3RE only reads the emails it receives, and nothing goes into your memory until you approve it. You can delete everything at any time.
page.noOntopo: No Ontopo bookings found in your emails. Some confirmations may have been sent by text message only.

page.qualifyHint: A booking doesn’t mean you went, or that you liked it. Next step: a few quick questions to tell me how these went.

deliveriesSheet.title: Excluded deliveries
deliveriesSheet.textTabit: These emails come from Tabit but are delivery orders. They will never count as a visit.
deliveriesSheet.text: These emails are delivery orders. They will never count as a visit.

setup.notReceiving: Receiving emails isn’t switched on in this version of WH3RE yet. Don’t set anything up in Gmail for now: nothing would arrive. This step will be available once WH3RE is live.
setup.chooseTitle: How do you want to find your bookings?

auto.title: Automatically, from Gmail
auto.text: 3 steps, 2 minutes. Gmail only sends booking emails to WH3RE, nothing else.

byHand.title: By hand, one email at a time
byHand.text: You forward a restaurant, hotel or activity confirmation yourself.

manual.title: Forward a confirmation
manual.step1: Open a confirmation email: a restaurant, a hotel, an activity.
manual.step2: Click “Forward” and send it to this address:
manual.step3: Send it from {email}, the address of your WH3RE account. It’ll show up here within seconds.
manual.deliveries: Deliveries are set aside: a Tabit or Wolt order isn’t a visit to the restaurant.

done.title: You’re all set.
done.activeText: Your new confirmations land here on their own. You approve them before they go into your memory.
done.text: Your next confirmation from Ontopo, Tabit, Booking or Airbnb will show up here on its own.
done.oldEmails: Gmail only forwards new emails. For your past bookings, <manual>forward them by hand</manual>.

step1.title: Give Gmail your WH3RE address
step1.open: Open Gmail, click “Add a forwarding address”, paste the address and confirm.
step1.workspace: Seeing a “Forward a copy of incoming mail to” field instead of the button? Leave it empty: it would forward your whole inbox. Some work accounts (Google Workspace) look like that.

step2.title: Confirm with the code
step2.codeSent: Gmail sent this code to WH3RE:
step2.codeSentFor: Gmail sent this code to WH3RE for {requester}:
step2.paste: Go back to Gmail, paste the code and click “Verify”.
step2.keepDisabled: Leave “Disable forwarding” selected: only booking emails will be forwarded, thanks to the next step.
step2.waiting: I’m waiting for the code Gmail sends to WH3RE. It’ll appear here on its own, within seconds.
step2.alreadyDone: I’ve already verified the code in Gmail

step3.title: Forward bookings only
step3.open: Open Gmail: the search for booking emails is already filled in.
step3.options: In the search bar, click the options icon (on the right), then “Create filter”.
step3.forward: Tick “Forward it to”, pick your WH3RE address, then click “Create filter”.
step3.copyQuery: Copy it and paste it into Gmail’s search bar:

qualify.noteHint: Optional · e.g. “Great vibe, but the music gets loud after 10 pm.”
qualify.doneLead: {count, plural, one {# place reviewed.} other {# places reviewed.}} WH3RE now knows what really matters to you, not just where you booked.
qualify.empty: Nothing to review for now. Forward a booking confirmation: it’ll show up here.
